description: Labelled utterances for the kids/adult range intent in ui_commands.py. Generated, then used as a regression suite by backend/tests/test_kids_range_phrases.py. Speech reaches the matcher via Whisper pinned to English (config.whisper_language), so Hindi appears romanized, never in Devanagari.

labels.child_explicit: Unambiguously a child, no age stated -> kids range.
labels.child_with_age: A child with a stated age <= 14 -> kids range.
labels.relative_no_age: A relative named with no age and nothing proving they are a child -> ASK the age.
labels.adult_relative: A relative with a stated age >= 15 -> adult range.
labels.for_self: Shopping for themselves / correcting an earlier assumption -> adult range.
labels.range_request: Asks for a department by name; see the 'range' field.
labels.none: Must NOT change the department at all.
